title: Fullbright+ Shaders
description: A lightweight Minecraft shader that removes darkness by providing full brightness, making caves, nights, and dim areas fully visible while keeping gameplay simple and performance-friendly. Compatible with Iris, Oculus, and OptiFine.
body:
![Preview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/EpUUYS1f/images/9a0c143743605981e6c09351b418f95ac9f5cc8b.png)

**Fullbright Shaders** is a _lightweight_ Minecraft shader designed to eliminate darkness by making the world appear fully illuminated at all times. 

It improves visibility in caves, during nighttime, underwater, and other low-light environments without requiring torches or other light sources. 

The shader focuses on simplicity and performance, providing a clean full-bright experience while remaining compatible with shader loaders such as Iris and OptiFine. 

It is intended for players who prefer enhanced visibility over realistic lighting effects.
